# Shreyash Atre - Software Engineer & Founder

Shreyash Atre is a Software Engineer specializing in full-stack development, scalable systems, and production-grade SaaS. He is a B.Sc. Computer Science student at Sir Parashurambhau College, Pune (Graduating 2027).

## Roles
- **Software Engineering Intern at Moash**: Engineering Menuara, a multi-tenant restaurant management SaaS.
- **Founder & Software Developer at Syantrex Technologies**: Building Syantrex ERP, a comprehensive system for retail and attendance management.
- **App Development Intern at Careasa Healthcare (Past)**: Developed real-time communication infrastructure and secure APIs.

## Key Projects
- **Menuara**: Multi-tenant SaaS with QR ordering and KDS.
- **Syantrex ERP**: High-density admin ecosystem for shop management.
- **DermaScanAI**: AI-based dermatological condition classifier (2nd Prize winner).
- **GRA – Resilience Agent**: Fault-tolerant AI sustainability platform.
- **OCR Assistant**: Real-time CV pipeline for document processing.
